checked.comment: Stochastic linear payoffs with adaptively adversarial contexts, conditionally R-sub-Gaussian noise; R and d used by the algorithm. Dimensions consistent with Section 2.1.
Gaussian-prior contextual TS; registry lin_ts lists this algorithm as an alias.

Matches eq. bound1 of Theorem 1: O(d^{3/2} sqrt(T)(ln T + sqrt(ln T ln(1/delta)))), with probability 1-delta. Regret defined through Delta_{a(t)}(t) against the per-round optimal arm. The analysed version uses v_t, so anytime.
Matches eq. bound2 of Theorem 1, with the paper's N (arms per round) mapped to n_act.

summary: The paper has one main guarantee, Theorem 1, which gives two high-probability bounds, and the extraction records both correctly. The setting, the algorithm's registry id and the cited results all match the source. I found no errors or missing results.
